description: Apply David Ogilvy's advertising principles when writing or reviewing copy, headlines, product descriptions, landing pages, ads, emails, or any persuasive text. Use when the goal is copy that sells, not copy that wins awards. Covers positioning, headlines, promises, brand voice, long-form copy, and visual logic. Source: How to Create Advertising That Sells (1972) + Ogilvy on Advertising.
